items.html: And know that in those seven lower ones of Atik, one cannot attain at all the upper half of the Hesed in them, but only from its middle downward. Therefore the Sages said that whoever gives birth at seven months gives birth in fragments, and it is not a full Ibur of all seven complete months. And from this interiority of the Mochin of ZON the souls of the righteous were also drawn and made.
